verdict.rationale: OpenRouter's docs say requests are load balanced across top providers by default, and routing can be customized per request with the `provider` object. The quickstart also says it picks the most cost-effective option per request. Only default provider-level balancing is documented, not engineer-controlled weighting. missing for 10: configurable weight-based distribution, explicit latency-based balancing controls, balancing across multiple keys or deployments, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can load-balance traffic across providers, deployments, or keys by weight, latency, or cost

citations.quote: By default, requests are load balanced across the top providers to maximize uptime.
You can customize how your requests are routed using the `provider` object in the request body
It handles fallbacks automatically and picks the most cost-effective option for each request.
